text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when I came to the library to return a book――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
――So, um...
About the event the Library Committee
is holding for this year's "Reading Promotion Week"...

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Shouldn't we just stick to what we usually do
and display the special edition of the library newsletter?

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
I get how you feel, but most of the girls
aren't really interested in reading anyway...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
B-But I thought this would be a wonderful opportunity
for everyone to get in touch with books...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
In the end, we couldn't decide on anything.
choice_data_list: Preparing for "Reading Promotion Week" seems tough.
Preparing for "Reading Promotion Week" seems like hard work.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah, um――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I asked Zenno Rob Roy about what happened,
it seemed the Library Committee members weren't very motivated
about the "Reading Promotion Week" event.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Since so many think "reading is too difficult,"
few students show interest in our events...
So most members feel there's no point putting effort in――

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
But... just giving up because it seems hard
is such a waste... and so lonely.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fairy tales, romances, heroic epics――by reading a book,
you can soar into any world imaginable...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You can become a lovely princess or a brave hero.
It's a gateway to dream worlds, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
True, some books are difficult...
But if people realized how many wonderful and fun ones
there are, I'm sure――
choice_data_list: Why not share that through the event?
Wouldn't it be great to convey that through the event?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're right...! If we can ease their hesitation
and show how thrilling books are――how magical stories can be
through our event, then maybe...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I heard everything!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rejoice♪ I, the genius magical girl Sweepy,
don't mind lending you a hand!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If we introduce magical stories alongside everything else,
everyone will finally realize how wonderful magic is!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
I would truly appreciate your help...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
All right, we have a deal!
Once it succeeds, you have to help me with my magic practice♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! If it's to share the wonders of books,
I'll accompany you in any kind of practice...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I've also wanted to thank you
for helping me out in the library all the time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
T-That's just because you're so clumsy
I couldn't stand watching! I only helped out of pity!!
choice_data_list: I'll help as much as I can too!
I'll help out as much as possible too!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Both of you...
Thank you so much!
